==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My dream was heavily influenced by yesterday's Google IO keynote. It largely focused on me experimenting with complex AI prompts. That's how the dream started.
But as the dream continued, I gained awareness of my body in the waking world. I consciously moved my body in my sleep. This granted me lucidity.
I didn't use my lucidity to do anything particularly amazing. If anything, it made me hyper aware of the time. I woke myself up a few minutes before my alarm went off.
